intro: Exterior and interior house painting in San Antonio, backed by a 5-year transferable exterior warranty. Local, woman-owned and family-run.
servicesIntro: Homes and businesses across San Antonio. Every project quoted free.

services.name: Exterior Painting
services.text: Thorough prep, moisture protection and premium paint, with a 5-year transferable warranty.

services.name: Interior House Painting
services.text: Walls, ceilings, trim, doors, staircases and built-ins, with low-odor paints, drop cloths and a 2-year transferable warranty.

services.name: Kitchen Cabinet Painting
services.text: Doors, drawers and hardware come off, and the cabinets are usually sprayed for a smooth, like-new finish.

services.name: Wood Rot Repair
services.text: Damaged trim, siding and window areas are repaired before painting, backed by a 2-year transferable warranty.

services.name: Popcorn Ceiling Removal
services.text: We remove the texture down to the drywall, prime, apply knockdown texture and paint.

services.name: Deck and Fence Staining
services.text: Transparent, semi-transparent and solid stains in over 30 colors, with a free 1-year courtesy visit.

why.name: Local, not franchise
why.text: Woman-owned and family-run, with no corporate office dictating the work.

why.name: Warranties that last
why.text: 5 years on exterior painting and 2 years on interior, all transferable.

why.name: No deposit, fixed quotes
why.text: Estimators measure and photograph the job, so you get a detailed fixed price. You pay when it is done.

howTitle: A fresh coat in three steps.

steps.name: Call for a free estimate
steps.text: We look at the work, ask questions and give you a flat price.

steps.name: We prep and paint
steps.text: We mask, scrape, caulk and prime, then paint. We buy all the supplies.

steps.name: Pay when it is done
steps.text: On most jobs, you pay nothing until everything is completely finished.
